name: Amaenbou ~Mou! Ikenai Ko ne~
original_name: あまえんぼう～もう！イケないコね～
source:
Main character is a spoiled young man bathing in attention since childhood. One summer he is invited to a family as a tutor. All the women here are sweet beauties. They accept protagonist as he is and even allow him to advance further than that...
